Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 30
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced incorrect data by listing “Quincy, Mass.” instead of the correct birthplace “Braintree, Massachusetts” for John Adams (and John Quincy Adams). This conflation of the modern municipality with the historical birthplace caused the downstream selection of “Quincy” as the easternmost city, leading WebSurfer to output “Honolulu, Quincy” instead of the correct “Braintree, Honolulu.”
